name: Property Hub
positioning: Salesforce-native CRM built specifically for flexible-workspace operators and the brokers who lease them.
description: Property Hub is a CRM built on the Salesforce platform for operators of flexible workspaces and the commercial real estate brokers who lease them. It manages listings, leads, tours and lease renewals in one place, and adds flex-market analytics such as price-per-desk benchmarks on top of standard CRM records.
real_estate_use: A flex-space operator's leasing team tracks incoming leads and scheduled tours for available desks and suites across its portfolio, and follows upcoming lease renewals from the same pipeline. A CRE broker specializing in flexible offices uses the same platform to match a client's requirement against available flex inventory and to check price-per-desk benchmarks for a given market before making an offer.
features: Native Salesforce integration with 500+ apps via API

use_cases.job: Track leads, tours and lease renewals for flexible-workspace inventory across a portfolio
Match a client's requirement to available flex-office inventory and check price-per-desk benchmarks
